description: Zero-division guard removed from percent(), contradicting its own docstring.
why_wrong: percent(x, 0) now raises ZeroDivisionError. The docstring still promises 0.0, so callers written against the documented behaviour will crash.
diff:
--- a/app/utils.py
+++ b/app/utils.py
@@ -18,6 +18,4 @@
 
 def percent(part: int, whole: int) -> float:
     """Return part/whole as a percentage. Returns 0.0 when whole is zero."""
-    if whole == 0:
-        return 0.0
     return (part / whole) * 100.0
